web.about_content:
Invite the Resonators to make your desktop their home!

Resonators journey from Solaris to your desktop, transforming into irresistibly cute digital friends. With every keystroke, they are ready to keep you company.

Wuwa Tappo is a Wuthering Waves-themed desktop pet software, officially licensed by Irox Games, the creators behind Bongo Cat. Each time you tap your keyboard, the Resonators spring to life, matching your rhythm with cheerful table pats. Whether you are working, studying, or just unwinding, these lively companions brighten up your screen, filling your day with energy and warmth.

Beyond its casual typing interaction gameplay, Wuwa Tappo also features a multiplayer online mode. Team up with friends and welcome even more adorable Resonators onto your desktop!

Game Features

  • Familiar Resonators become charming desktop pets.
  • Enjoy playful interactions with every keystroke, keeping you company through work, study, and downtime.
  • Unlock chests to collect characters, accessories, and character-exclusive emotes.
  • Dive into a treasure trove of collectibles: over 200 [Characters], 100 [Accessories], and 500 [Emotes] await.
  • Host multiplayer sessions with up to 20 friends, sharing joyful moments together.
  • Permanently free to download and play.

Chest Acquisition Rules

Click your mouse or tap your keyboard to rack up character counts, earn chests as you stay active, and discover new collectibles!

  • Every 30 minutes of action generates a chest in your slot.
  • Claiming a chest uses 1,000 characters; after claiming, 1,000 will be deducted from your counter, and the next 30-minute timer automatically begins.
  • You can store up to 2 unclaimed chests. If both slots are full, the timer pauses until you claim a chest and free up space.

Open chests for a chance to collect items of varying types and rarities.

Complimentary Collectibles on First Login

Launch Wuwa Tappo for the first time and receive a starter set of collectibles. Let Rover, Abby, and delightful emotes jumpstart your daily desktop adventures!

Character

  • Rover (Male): Classic
  • Rover (Female): Classic

Accessory

  • Abby

Emote

  • Abby: Happy
  • Abby: Exertion
  • Abby: Pain
  • Abby: Stunned
  • Abby: Angry
  • Abby: Surprise
  • Abby: Threat
  • Abby: Smug

Collectible Rarity and Acquisition Probability

  • Common: 90%
  • Uncommon: 9.5%
  • Rare: 0.49%
  • Epic: 0.01%

Starter Guarantee and Exclusive Emote Rules

  • Your first chest guarantees a [Character].
  • Your second chest guarantees a random [Accessory].
  • Once you collect a character, their exclusive emotes are added to the loot pool.

Device Requirements

Minimum Requirements:

  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • CPU: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen or above) or AMD Ryzen 5 equivalent
  • RAM: 4 GB or above
  • GPU: Any
  • Storage: 200 MB of available space

Recommended Requirements:

  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • CPU: Intel Core i5 (10th Gen or above) or AMD Ryzen 5 equivalent
  • RAM: 8 GB or above
  • GPU: Any
  • Storage: 1 GB of available space

Power up your computer, start typing, and let's fill today with the joy of Resonators!
